newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly firm, gasoline sails west.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly firm, gasoline sails west.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly steady on Wednesday, traders said.
Gasoline prices held steady despite falling futures, with three or four new cargoes having been sold transatlantic.

Gas oil premiums were stable as outright prices returned briefly to five-year highs. The first U.S. arbitrage cargoes are set to hit the market at the end of this week, and five Ventspils cargoes are due to load before the end of September.
High sulphur fuel oil barges rose sharply, gaining up to $3 at $113-115 fob ARA.
